# Fanfarr v0.5.31

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Library sync actually writes directors

The parser read them, per-item Refresh wrote them, but the section sync built
its own upsert map without the key -- so running Sync library never filled the
new Director filter, and only opening a title one by one did. Both writers now
read one shared mapping, so a parsed field cannot arrive on one path and miss
the other again. An empty listing keeps the stored value rather than wiping
it.

## Housekeeping

- `usage_rules` installed: dependency guidance syncs to `USAGE_RULES.md`,
  deliberately not into `AGENTS.md`, which stays the curated decision record.
- The trim panel and the bulk dialog share one crop-length parser instead of
  two identical copies.
- The source-cache test isolates its own directory: parallel partitions share
  one box, and its cleanup could land mid-run of another partition.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
